spec.scope: Self, on-full-charge attacks only (RL, chargeFrames 90 — every completed pull is a full charge, so trigger cadence ≈ per shot).

spec.triggerIdentity: shotFired on the owner's full-charge shots (a 'performing a Full Charge attack' self-trigger).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding 'Explosion Radius ▲' as a damage stat — most plausibly projectileExplosionPct (RL-flavored Damage-Up) or attackDamagePct — turning a pure AoE-geometry stat into free per-shot damage. Explosion RADIUS changes how many enemies a splash covers, not the damage to any enemy it hits; vs the single partless scope-lock boss it moves nothing. There is also no StatKey for explosion radius, which is itself the tell that it belongs in `unmodeled`.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: cfg.onEvent: zero buffApply events with caster belorta carrying stat 'projectileExplosionPct' or 'attackDamagePct'; and totals(res)['belorta'] is IDENTICAL when run with withPatchedOverride('belorta', o => { o.skill1 = []; }) — skill1 must be a strict no-op on damage.

spec.targetSet: the target(s) — the enemies hit (boss debuff, would emit buffApply with casterIdx===null/targetIdx===null if modeled).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two plausible misreads: (a) reading 'hits more than 4 enemy unit(s)' as a hit-COUNT trigger ('every 4+ hits' → hitCount:5 or hitCount:4), making the DEF ▼ + 14.96% rider fire continuously all fight; (b) treating the RL splash as auto-satisfying the gate and shipping it ungated per-shot. Both over-credit a line that is dead in this fight.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: cfg.onEvent: ZERO damage events with srcSlot === belorta's slot and bucket 'skill' (the 14.96% rider must never land), and zero buffApply events carrying a DEF-down/damageTakenPct-style stat with value 3.52. Additionally totals(res)['belorta'] identical with o.skill2 = [].
spec.inertness: The entire skill2 block: no skill-bucket damage from belorta, no boss debuff, no gauge contribution from a phantom rider (a wrongly-shipped 14.96% rider would also pump burst gauge via skill-damage impacts — another observable to hold at zero).

spec.distinguishingAssertion: Same as above: no belorta skill-bucket damage events at all across a full 180s run; her damage comes exclusively from buckets 'normal'/'charge' (weapon) and 'burst'.

notes: Harness caveat the driver must reconcile: belorta is Burst II, but controlComp(carry) fixes the carry in the B3 slot (liter B1 / crown B2 / carry B3 / helm B3) — her tests need a custom CompOptions placing her in the B2 slot with a B1 + B3 present so full bursts actually chain; the burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter distinguisher specifically needs crown (or another B2) co-present and rotating. Expected shared-prior misreads, in order of likelihood: (1) skill2's '>4 enemy unit(s)' gate silently dropped or reread as a hitCount trigger, shipping a permanent 14.96% per-shot rider + DEF shred that the single-boss fight can never legitimately produce — this is the biggest damage-inflation trap in the kit (~24% of her 61.3 normal mult per shot if shipped ungated); (2) the 192% burst hit taking the +50% FB major (it must land pre-FB, fbMajorApplied false); (3) Explosion Radius laundered into projectileExplosionPct/attackDamagePct damage — radius is AoE geometry, damage-inert vs one partless boss, and has no StatKey by design; (4) burst charge-speed keyed to fullBurstEnter. Whole-picture check: with skill1+skill2 correctly unmodeled, belorta's sim damage = RL weapon cycle (6 ammo, 141-frame reload, 90-frame charge, 61.3/200 mults) + 192% per own burst — any skill-bucket damage event from her slot is by itself proof of a misencoding. All magnitudes are literal kit text (DATAMINED); nothing here requires a ⚡/⚑ calibrated value, and no ALWAYS-⚑ field applies (no kit-silent cadence, no swap, no stacks, no multi-projectile split beyond the boss-irrelevant radius line).
